Container.Name: drocsid
Container.Overview: drocsid flips movie night right-side up. Stream your Plex library into a Discord voice channel, synced to the frame for the whole crew. Friends can browse and hit play without ever touching your Plex server, and you run it all from a self-hosted web panel.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Web portal and setup wizard. Point your reverse proxy (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager) at this port for the public https address.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings, play history, lineup and watch progress
